title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
description:
MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und moderne Longevity-Anwendungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen.

Innerhalb von nur drei Jahren sind wir auf 10 Standorte und mehr als 50.000 Kunden gewachsen. Damit gehören wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen im Bereich der ästhetischen Medizin in Deutschland.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs noch deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als eine der führenden Marken für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren.

Unser Erfolgsmodell basiert auf einem klaren Anspruch: hohe medizinische Qualität ohne Kompromisse für Alle zugänglich

Unsere Behandlungen werden ausschließlich von Ärzten durchgeführt. Wir arbeiten mit den hochwertigsten Produkten führender Hersteller und setzen auf standardisierte Prozesse, intensive Schulungen und eine konsequent hohe Behandlungs- und Servicequalität.

Unser Ziel ist nicht der kurzfristige "Verkauf" einzelner Behandlungen, sondern der Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch Qualität, Vertrauen und ein konstant exzellentes Kundenerlebnis.

Der Markt für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity wächst sehr stark. Gleichzeitig verändern sich die Erwartungen der Kunden: Behandlungen sollen professioneller, zugänglicher und selbstverständlicher werden.

Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir aktiv voran.

Deine Mission

Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 und oder 100 Standorte schafft.

Aufgaben

Deine Verantwortung

Du trägst die operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Standorte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unsere Operations kontinuierlich weiter.

Leadership & People

Du führst unsere operativen Kollegen und späteren Führungskräfte und sorgst dafür, dass Führung nicht nur auf dem Papier stattfindet, sondern im täglichen Geschäft spürbar ist.

Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst eindeutige Verantwortlichkeiten.

Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig und entwickelst sie weiter.

Genauso konsequent gehst du mit Underperformance um.

Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Recruiting Team dafür, dass unsere Standorte jederzeit mit den richtigen Menschen besetzt sind und wir auch bei starkem Wachstum oder Ausfällen unsere personellen Standards halten.

Training & Development

Du entwickelst strukturierte Trainings- und Weiterbildungsprogramme für unsere Teams.

Du führst Trainings selbst durch und entwickelst gleichzeitig Strukturen, mit denen Wissen innerhalb der Organisation skalierbar weitergegeben werden kann.

Du etablierst klare Standards für Onboarding, Führung, Verkauf, Kundenservice und operative Abläufe.

Dabei misst du nicht nur, ob Trainings stattgefunden haben, sondern ob sie tatsächlich zu besserer Performance führen.

Operational Excellence

Du analysierst sämtliche operativen Prozesse unseres Unternehmens und stellst sie kontinuierlich infrage.

Was funktioniert, wird standardisiert.

Was nicht funktioniert, wird verändert.

Was unnötig kompliziert ist, wird vereinfacht.

Du entwickelst SOPs, Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse, die für jeden Standort klar verständlich und reproduzierbar sind.

Dein Anspruch ist, dass ein Kunde unabhängig vom Standort ein konstant hohes MY-HEALTH-&-BEAUTY-Erlebnis erhält.

Performance & KPIs

Du steuerst Operations anhand von Zahlen und nicht anhand von Bauchgefühl.

Du definierst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die relevanten operativen KPIs und stellst sicher, dass diese transparent, verstanden und konsequent gesteuert werden.

Dazu gehören insbesondere Produktivität, Personaleinsatz, Auslastung, Umsatzperformance, Kundenbindung, Servicequalität und operative Effizienz.

Wenn ein Standort seine Ziele verfehlt, analysierst du nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern findest heraus, warum.

Anschließend entwickelst du konkrete Maßnahmen, definierst Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher.

Customer Experience & Qualitätsanspruch

Wir wollen nicht durchschnittlich gut sein.

Unser Anspruch ist ein außergewöhnlich hohes Niveau in jedem einzelnen Standort.

Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Standards hinsichtlich Kundenservice, Organisation, Sauberkeit, Auftreten, Kommunikation und operativer Qualität konsequent eingehalten werden.

Du erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und greifst ein, bevor aus kleinen Problemen strukturelle Probleme werden.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

Diese Position ist bewusst nicht für jeden geeignet.

Wir suchen einen leistungsorientierten Menschen mit einem sehr hohen eigenen Anspruch.

Du solltest bereits bewiesen haben, dass du Menschen führen, operative Strukturen verbessern und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen kannst.

Was du zwingend mitbringen solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Führungserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen operativen Organisation.

Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung größerer Teams und mehrerer Führungsebenen.

Idealerweise hast du bereits Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte oder dezentrale operative Einheiten getragen.

Du hast Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeiter nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern tatsächlich zu entwickeln, zu motivieren und leistungsfähiger zu machen.

Du kannst professionelle Trainingskonzepte entwickeln und bist gleichzeitig stark genug in Kommunikation und Auftreten, diese Trainings selbst durchzuführen.

Du bist zahlengetrieben und kannst aus KPIs konkrete operative Entscheidungen ableiten.

Du hast bereits Prozesse aufgebaut oder grundlegend verbessert und kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Arbeit messbar zu besseren Ergebnissen geführt hat.

Du kannst gleichzeitig strategisch und extrem hands-on arbeiten.

Du kommunizierst klar, direkt und verbindlich und scheust dich nicht davor, auch unangenehme Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsgefühl und wartest bei Problemen nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Wir suchen keine Person, die möglichst viele Aufgaben delegiert und Operations hauptsächlich aus Meetings und Reports heraus steuert.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das Unternehmen wirklich verstehen will.

Jemanden, der regelmäßig in unseren Standorten präsent ist.

Der mit Mitarbeitern spricht.

Der Kunden beobachtet.

Der Prozesse selbst durchläuft.

Der Probleme sieht, bevor sie in einem Dashboard auftauchen.

Und der anschließend Strukturen schafft, damit diese Probleme dauerhaft gelöst werden.

Du solltest einen außergewöhnlich hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Umsetzung haben.

Wir arbeiten in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen. Damit gehen Veränderung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und Phasen außergewöhnlicher Belastung einher.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung nicht an seiner Stellenbeschreibung oder an der Uhr festmacht. Wenn eine wichtige Standorteröffnung ansteht, ein Team Unterstützung benötigt oder ein operatives Problem gelöst werden muss, erwarten wir Ownership und die Bereitschaft, die Extrameile zu gehen.

Was für uns zählt, sind Ergebnisse.

Dein Mindset

Du denkst unternehmerisch.

Du willst gestalten statt verwalten.

Du stellst hohe Anforderungen an dich selbst und an dein Team.

Du kannst Menschen begeistern, aber genauso klare Grenzen setzen.

Du bist extrem lösungsorientiert.

Du suchst bei Problemen nicht nach Erklärungen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, sondern nach einem nachhaltigen Weg, es zu lösen.

Du kannst Prioritäten setzen und auch unter Druck klar entscheiden.

Du hast keine Angst vor Verantwortung.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich keinen Verwalter bestehender Strukturen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Strukturen hinterfragt, Schwachstellen erkennt, Lösungen entwickelt und diese konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der strategisch denken kann, aber genauso selbstverständlich selbst vor Ort ist, mit Teams arbeitet, Trainings durchführt, Probleme löst und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Benefits

If you want to learn how to build a company, enjoy creating things from scratch and care deeply about results, this is an opportunity to own a meaningful part of Mercura from day one.

What we’re looking for

title: Director of Corporate Development
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional Corporate Development role.

As Director of Corporate Development, you will work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for building Andercore's M&A engine from the ground up. You will help define our roll-up strategy, identify and approach acquisition targets, develop investment cases and execute transactions end-to-end. At the same time, you will work closely with our technology and operating teams to answer the question at the heart of our strategy:

How can we acquire traditional industrial businesses and use technology and AI to make them dramatically better?

This means thinking beyond financial engineering and traditional buy-and-build.

You will help identify where AI, automation, centralized procurement, data, pricing, sales productivity, working-capital optimization and shared infrastructure can fundamentally improve the economics of acquired businesses.

Your mandate is ultimately to build a repeatable acquisition and value-creation machine capable of executing multiple transactions every year.

What You Will Own

M&A & Roll-Up Strategy

  • Take Andercore's acquisition and consolidation strategy across Europe to the next level.

  • Identify attractive verticals, geographies and acquisition archetypes.

  • Build market maps and identify highly fragmented markets suitable for consolidation.

  • Develop the financial and strategic logic behind our roll-up thesis.

  • Determine where Andercore's technology and AI capabilities can create disproportionate value after acquisition.

  • Build a multi-year acquisition roadmap together with the CEO and Board.

Proprietary Deal Origination

  • Build and continuously develop a proprietary pipeline of acquisition opportunities.

  • Identify and directly approach founders and owners of attractive businesses.

  • Build trusted relationships with entrepreneurs, often long before they consider selling.

  • Develop systematic, data-driven sourcing approaches.

  • Build relationships with investment banks, M&A boutiques, advisers and other intermediaries.

We expect proprietary sourcing to become a core competitive advantage of Andercore's M&A strategy.

Deal Execution

Own transactions from first conversation through closing:

  • Initial assessment and strategic fit

  • Financial analysis and valuation

  • Investment cases

  • Deal structuring

  • LOIs

  • Negotiation

  • Commercial, financial, tax and legal due diligence

  • Financing

  • Board and shareholder materials

  • Signing and closing

You will coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisers while remaining personally accountable for moving transactions forward.

AI-Driven Value Creation

Our ambition is not simply to acquire businesses. It is to transform them.

Together with Andercore's technology and operating teams, you will identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and our central platform across areas such as:

  • Sales productivity and customer intelligence

  • Pricing and margin optimization

  • Procurement

  • Supplier management

  • Customer service

  • Finance and administration

  • Working capital

  • Logistics and fulfilment

  • Data and reporting

You will incorporate these opportunities into acquisition theses and quantify their potential impact before we invest.

Integration & Portfolio Value Creation

  • Develop Day-1 and 100-day plans before closing.

  • Translate investment theses into measurable operational initiatives.

  • Define integration priorities together with functional leaders.

  • Track acquisition performance against the original investment case.

  • Identify additional opportunities for technology deployment, synergies and operational improvement.

The objective is not necessarily to integrate everything immediately. It is to determine what should be centralized, what should remain entrepreneurial and where Andercore's platform creates the greatest advantage.

Build the M&A Machine

You will build the infrastructure required to turn acquisitions into a repeatable capability using the latest AI stack:

  • M&A playbook

  • Target database and pipeline

  • Valuation frameworks

  • Investment committee processes

  • Due diligence standards

  • Deal documentation

  • Integration playbooks

  • Portfolio reporting

  • Value-creation tracking

As our acquisition pace increases, you will build and lead a dedicated Corporate Development team.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an exceptional investor and operator. The strongest candidates will likely come from:

  • Leading Private Equity funds, particularly buy-and-build or mid-market investing

  • Top-tier Investment Banking / M&A

  • Corporate Development at a highly acquisitive company

  • A combination of Investment Banking and Private Equity

You will likely bring 5–10 years of relevant experience, including meaningful exposure to transactions.

Experience in industrial distribution, business services, industrial technology or fragmented-market consolidation is particularly valuable.

You combine:

  • Exceptional financial and analytical capabilities

  • Strong commercial judgment

  • Deep understanding of M&A

  • Excellent negotiation skills

  • Entrepreneurial instinct

  • High ownership and execution intensity

  • Ability to build relationships with entrepreneurs and business owners

  • Intellectual curiosity around AI and technology

You do not need to be an AI engineer.

But you should be deeply interested in understanding how AI changes businesses, cost structures and competitive advantages — and how those changes can create entirely new acquisition strategies.

German and English fluency are highly preferred.

Who You Are

  • You think like an investor but operate like an entrepreneur.

  • You enjoy understanding businesses quickly and identifying what makes them valuable.

  • You are comfortable calling a founder yourself, building the model yourself, negotiating an LOI and presenting the investment case to the Board.

  • You don't need an established process around you. You build the process.

  • You combine analytical rigor with speed and pragmatism.

  • And you are excited by the opportunity to help answer one of the most interesting questions emerging in private equity and technology today:

What happens when you combine the traditional power of a roll-up with the transformational potential of AI?

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Established Andercore's M&A and roll-up strategy.

  • Built a substantial proprietary acquisition pipeline.

  • Created a repeatable sourcing and transaction process.

  • Built Andercore's M&A playbook.

  • Developed a clear framework for AI and technology-driven value creation.

  • Led multiple transactions from initial contact through advanced negotiations.

  • Closed our first acquisitions.

  • Established the foundations for executing multiple acquisitions every year.

Over time, you will build Andercore's Corporate Development organization and play a central role in building a new category of European industrial company.

Why Andercore

  • This is an opportunity to build rather than inherit.

  • You will work directly with Andercore's founders, Board and investors and have significant responsibility from day one.

  • You will combine private equity, entrepreneurship, technology and AI in one role.

  • And rather than advising companies or investing from the outside, you will help build the platform itself.

Our ambition is significant:

to create Europe's leading AI-native industrial distribution platform through a combination of organic growth, acquisitions and technology-driven transformation.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die gesamte Product Organisation von Pammys und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter.

  • Du verknüpfst Produktentwicklung stärker mit Consumer Insights und Marketing und stellst sicher, dass neue Produkte auf reale Kundenbedürfnisse, klare Positionierung und kommerzielles Skalierungspotenzial ausgerichtet sind.
  • Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren Teams, Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in Asien und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Produkt- und Produktionsfragen ein.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung einer multidisziplinären Product Organisation.
  • Tiefgehendes Know-how in Footwear Development, Engineering, Construction, Materials, Fit, Sampling, Testing und Production.
  • Langjährige direkte Erfahrung mit Footwear-Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in China sowie idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk im asiatischen Beschaffungsmarkt.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Sourcing, Costing, Supplier Management, Production Planning und kommerziellen Verhandlungen.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Produktportfolios, Kategorien und internationalen Produktlinien.
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Pricing, Herstellkosten, Volumen, Sortiment und Produktprofitabilität.
  • Du kannst Strategie auf C-Level entwickeln und gleichzeitig operativ tief genug einsteigen, um komplexe Product-, Development- oder Production-Probleme selbst zu verstehen und voranzutreiben.
  • Du bist ein Builder und fühlst dich in einer Organisation wohl, in der Strukturen nicht vollständig vorgegeben sind, sondern von dir geschaffen werden.
  • Du führst mit hohen Standards, klarer Verantwortung und starker Execution.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen schnell, datenbasiert und mit ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Verständnis.
  • Sehr gutes Englisch sowie hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft, insbesondere nach China und zu unseren Produktionspartnern.
  • Standortnähe zu Hamburg beziehungsweise die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort mit unserem Team zu arbeiten.

  • Build instead of manage: Du übernimmst keine fertige Konzernorganisation, sondern kannst Teams, Strukturen, Prozesse und Verantwortlichkeiten aktiv aufbauen.
  • Direkter Einfluss auf unser Wachstum: Du entscheidest maßgeblich mit, welche Produkte und Kategorien Pammys in den kommenden Jahren entwickelt und skaliert.
  • Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern: Produktentscheidungen werden schnell getroffen und du bist unmittelbar an den wichtigsten strategischen Entscheidungen beteiligt.

  • Hohe Geschwindigkeit: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Wenn wir überzeugt sind, setzen wir um.
  • Starkes Fundament: Du baust auf einer Footwear Brand mit über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden auf und gestaltest von hier aus die nächste Wachstumsphase.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eine Product Organisation entwickeln, die auf Geschwindigkeit, Qualität, Profitabilität und internationale Skalierung ausgelegt ist.
  • Executive Package: Ein der Verantwortung, Erfahrung und dem Impact der Rolle entsprechendes Vergütungspaket inklusive leistungsabhängiger Komponenten.
  • Standort Hamburg mit direkter Nähe zu Gründern, Leadership Team und zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der eine baut.

title: (Mandatory) Internship Technical Founder's Associate (m/w/d)
description:
About CyFract

We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. Founded in 2022, we develop a patented uniflow hydrocyclone that removes suspended solids without membranes, consumables or moving parts, at a fraction of the energy conventional systems require. Having completed the UnternehmerTUM Incubator and a €3M project financed by SPRIN-D (German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation), we successfully deployed two containerized pilot systems and are conducting validation projects with industrial partners. We are now building the team that will carry this from working prototype to industrial standard, and we are looking for the people who want to build it with us.

The Role

As Technical Founder's Associate, you will work directly with the founding team on our core technology. Over the coming months our separation geometry will be tested with pilot partners. You will be one of the people who builds the test setup, runs the measurements, and turns the results into something we can act on. This is not a role where you reproduce something that already works. Parts of what you build will be the first of their kind, and some of them will fail. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. You will sit close to the founding team and see how an early stage company actually runs: how decisions get made, what gets prioritised and why, and what a founder's week really looks like. Your measurements and your judgement feed directly into those decisions.

Tasks

  • Build, modify and operate our Munich test rig; run and document test series
  • Design and iterate cyclone and guide-vane geometries in CAD and prepare print-ready files
  • 3D print, post-process, assemble and pressure-test prototypes
  • Build out the measurement chain: sensors, data acquisition, evaluation

Requirements

  • Enrolled in environmental engineering, mechanical engineering, process engineering, physics or a related field
  • Hands-on CAD and 3D printing experience
  • Demonstrable build experience: a personal project, workshop time, or study projects
  • Independent working style
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in German and English

What sets you apart

  • Fluid mechanics, ideally with CFD (Ansys Fluent, OpenFOAM, SimScale)
  • Experience with pumps, piping or hydraulic loops
  • Systems-level thinking that connects hardware, measurement and data
  • Experience in water treatment, circular economy or industrial hardware projects

Benefits

Why CyFract?

Water is the only resource with no substitute. There is no alternative to it, and there never will be. Yet we treat it as though it were free: we use it once, contaminate it, and spend enormous amounts of energy trying to make it usable again. That is the problem we work on. We offer you a seat in the room where it gets solved:

Iteration speed. Sketch a geometry in the morning, print it in the afternoon, test it the next day.

You see the whole loop. CAD, print, assembly, measurement chain, data, and the report that goes to our partners.

Direct collaboration with the founders. No layer in between, and ownership of your own components.

Long-term opportunities. Upon successful completion of the project, we may offer you a working student position or a role as Founding Engineer.

This position is open both to students completing a mandatory internship required by their study regulations and to students doing a voluntary internship alongside or between their studies. The work is primarily on-site in Munich-Bogenhausen, with limited home office possible for tasks that allow it.

If you want to build things that have not been built before, send us your motivational letter, your CV, and a one-pager on a past project that shows how you work.

Not a perfect fit on paper? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and how you build than about ticking every box, and we may well hire more than one person.

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. Die Onepage GmbH ist ein AI-first-SaaS-Unternehmen mit 19.000 zahlenden Kunden und über 250.000 Usern und zählt damit zu den größten Plattformen im Bereich Web-Präsenz im deutschsprachigen Raum. Drumherum bauen wir ein Portfolio aus Software-Brands auf, die für unsere Zielgruppe – kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie Agenturen – relevant sind.
Dafür bauen wir eine neue Funktion im Unternehmen auf – und suchen die Person, die sie gemeinsam mit uns aufbaut. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem CEO und dem Finance-Team, baust die Pipeline auf, bewertest Deals und pflegst den Kontakt zu Eigentümern potenzieller Targets.

Du willst nicht nur Deals begleiten, sondern mitdenken, mitverhandeln und mitentscheiden? Komm als M&A Manager (m/w/d) an Bord!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marktscreening & Target Identifikation: Du identifizierst potenzielle Übernahmekandidaten (Targets) und wertest diese gemeinsam mit unserem CEO und Finance-Team nach strategischen Kriterien aus.
  • Deal-Flow & Pipeline: Du baust unseren Deal-Flow systematisch auf – über Direktansprache, Broker, Netzwerke und unser Ökosystem aus Kunden und Agenturpartnern – und hältst die Pipeline strukturiert nach.
  • Austausch mit Targets: Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit Eigentümern und Management potenzieller Zielunternehmen und baust eine erste Gesprächsbasis auf.
  • Deal-Analyse & Bewertung: Du erstellst gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team Unternehmensbewertungen (u. a. DCF, Multiplikatorverfahren) und Business Cases für mögliche Transaktionen.
  • Due Diligence: Du unterstützt bei der kaufmännischen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Prüfung von Zielunternehmen – in Abstimmung mit CEO, Finance-Team und externen Beratern (Anwälte, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer).
  • Verhandlung & Strukturierung: Du bereitest Verhandlungen von Term Sheets, LOIs und Kaufverträgen mit vor und begleitest diese gemeinsam mit dem CEO.
  • Transaktionsbegleitung: Du begleitest Transaktionen von der Anbahnung bis zum Signing/Closing in enger Abstimmung mit CEO und Finance.
  • Post-Merger-Integration: Du unterstützt bei der Integrationsplanung nach erfolgtem Zukauf und entwickelst mit uns ein Integrations-Playbook, das wir Deal für Deal wiederverwenden.

  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in M&A, Investment Banking, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance oder Strategieberatung.

  • Know-how: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Unternehmensbewertung und Finanzmodellierung.
  • SaaS-Verständnis: Du verstehst, wie Software-Unternehmen ticken – ARR, Net Revenue Retention, Churn, CAC – und kannst daraus eine Bewertungslogik ableiten. Erfahrung mit Buy-&-Build-Modellen oder Software-Deals ist ein großes Plus.
  • Due Diligence: Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Begleitung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen.

  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

title: Engineering Manager (f/m/d)
Manager of Data Science & Analytics, Payments Intelligence
MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We want you as a talented MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing significantly to Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology, development and in-house production for our Vehicles Nyx Earth and Nyx Moon.

The ideal candidate will play a key role as an Application Engineer, working on the development and qualification of additive manufacturing (AM) processes, including the definition of print parameters for new materials. This role will also involve supporting the certification of AM components to comply with high industry standards, including NASA regulations. .

Role Overview

As an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, qualification, and industrialization of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) technologies for critical aerospace hardware.

You will support the full lifecycle of aerospace hardware, from manufacturability assessment and process development through qualification, certification, and production readiness. Working closely with Design Engineering, Materials & Processes, Quality, Testing, and Manufacturing teams, you will contribute to the delivery of flight-ready components across TEC's propulsion and space systems programs.

This is a technically demanding role with direct impact on flight hardware development, manufacturing capability, and future production scalability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the manufacturing and qualification of mission-critical flight hardware.

  • Develop, optimize, and qualify LPBF processes for a range of high-performance alloys.

  • Define and manage material characterization campaigns, support test execution, and analyze the resulting data.

  • Take over build preparation, LPBF process simulation, and process monitoring data analysis.

  • Execute qualification and certification activities for AM hardware in accordance with aerospace requirements and internal quality processes.

  • Troubleshoot manufacturing challenges and drive continuous improvement in process capability, quality, productivity, and inspection methodologies.

  • Author technical documentation and collaborate with internal teams, external suppliers, laboratories, and certification bodies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

Prinzipien unserer Zusammenarbeit: Du moderierst Rollen- und Spannungssessions sowie Retrospektiven. Darüber hinaus planst Du Trainings zu gewaltfreier Kommunikation und zur Übung von Entscheidungsprozessen.

Organisationsentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit: Du nimmst Bedürfnisse, Dynamiken und Spannungen in der Organisation wahr, greifst neue interne und externe Impulse auf und leitest gemeinsam mit den Leads des HOD-Kreises passende Veränderungen für unsere Zusammenarbeit, Prozesse und Formate ab.

Wissensmanagement: Du sorgst dafür, dass Vorlagen, Prozesswissen, Lernerfahrungen und Entscheidungen verständlich dokumentiert, leicht auffindbar und für die tägliche Arbeit tatsächlich nutzbar sind – in Notion und in Lernformaten.


Dein Profil

So geht es weiter

Du möchtest Teil von ProjectTogether werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deinen Lebenslauf und Dein persönliches Anschreiben. 

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht – wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, auch wenn Du die Ansprüche noch nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, aber die Motivation mitbringst, Dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen.

You will leverage modern workflows—initially building and auditing multi-variable models in Microsoft Excel using the Claude for Excel add-in, with a direct, subsequent mandate to act as a core product stakeholder driving our platform migration to Pigment.



KEY SKILLS

To excel in this role, you must bring a sharp blend of institutional corporate finance discipline, modern data literacy, and a forward-looking technology stack:

  • Strategic Architecture: Mastery of 3-statement long-range planning (LRP), rolling monthly forecasting, and corporate top-down / bottom-up budget reconciliation.

  • Tactical Liquidity Control: Active management of short-term cash mechanics, specifically building 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts.

  • Mobile Ecosystem Domain Expertise: Deep familiarity with B2C mobile metrics (ROAS, LTV, CAC, and cohort curves) and institutional debt facility covenant tracking.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Own the Global Planning Cycle Engine & Budget Setting: Act as the architect and coordinator of Codeway’s global budget setting and forecasting process. You will build and own the corporate top-down strategic forecasting model and lead the continuous process of coordinating and consolidating the bottom-up inputs from the FBP network. You will design, establish, and push unified planning templates out to the FBPs, running a rigorous rolling monthly forecast to keep the global corporate model perfectly synchronised with live business pacing. You will partner closely with FBPs to challenge operational assumptions, extract key variables, and align strategic direction to fuel "The Engine."

  • Enterprise Valuation & Long-Range Planning (LRP): Build and scale corporate three-statement models and integrated multi-year cash flow frameworks explicitly designed to evaluate macro strategic options, support capital structuring, and drive long-term corporate value creation.

While they evaluate cohort dynamics across our apps to maximise ROAS, you will integrate their marketing deployment outputs into our central business plan, reconciling portfolio allocation shifts directly against corporate cash reserves and growth capital constraints.

Monitor global capital drawdowns, track funding velocity against strict covenant thresholds, and generate institutional-grade financial reporting for our lending partners.

  • Multi-Dimensional Portfolio Cost Allocations: Architect and manage the cost allocation framework required to distribute centralised overhead (shared engineering, global data lakes, corporate G&A) down to individual app-level P&Ls to isolate and report true fully loaded unit economics.

  • Advanced Scenario Modeling: Build dynamic, driver-based sensitivity models to instantly simulate shifting ecosystem dynamics and top-of-funnel marketing performance, cleanly integrating core growth metrics (ROAS, LTV, and CAC).

  • Board Preparation & Headcount Alignment: Synthesise complex data into premium corporate narratives and visual decks for quarterly board reviews. Partner closely with the Talent Acquisition (TA) team to ensure global hiring plans and recruitment velocity reconcile perfectly with approved corporate budget constraints.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Elite Individual Contributor Profile: A high-autonomy operator who executes with urgency. You are highly proactive, you drive projects forward independently, and take immense pride in the technical integrity of your models.

  • The Codeway Ethos: A natural self-starter who looks forward, not backward. You completely avoid an audit or ledger-heavy mindset; you treat finance as an agile, value-generating growth partner, and possess the conviction to challenge leadership constructively in a founder-led culture.

  • Collaborative Matrix Skills: Strong foundational background in corporate consolidation and recurring planning windows. You excel at extracting variables from decentralised partners, using high-impact communication to pressure-test assumptions and seamlessly turn operational data into continuous rolling monthly forecasts.

description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

description:
Reflecta demokratisiert den Zugang zu Netzwerk, Wissen und Fördermitteln. Seit 2010 bringen wir Menschen zusammen, die die Gesellschaft zukunftsfähig machen wollen: zunächst mit Offline-Formaten, seit 2019 digital. Heute ist Reflecta ein lernendes Ökosystem mit einer Community von über 10.000 Zukunftsgestalter:innen. Sein jüngstes Kapitel ist der Fördermittelkompass, die größte strukturierte Förderdatenbank im deutschsprachigen Raum, im Abo genutzt von Organisationen aus Zivilgesellschaft, Wohlfahrt, Kommunen und Unternehmen, dazu Landeseinrichtungen und Stiftungen über eigene Portale.

Hinter dem Ökosystem steht eine gemeinnützige GmbH mit einem Team von sieben Personen, remote first und wachsend. Mit dem Wachstum teilen wir die Führung in klare Ressorts: Unsere Gründerin Daniela Mahr verantwortet die Gesamtvision, Partnerschaften und die Außenvertretung von Reflecta, Mitgründer und CTO Simon Franzen die technische Entwicklung. Wir suchen eine zweite Geschäftsführung, die die operative und kaufmännische Verantwortung übernimmt: Finanzen, Teamrhythmus und laufende Projekte.

Du startest als COO mit dem klaren Ziel, als zweite Geschäftsführer:in bestellt zu werden.

Aufgaben

Finanzen verantworten: Budget, Liquiditätsplanung, Controlling. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatung (Jahresabschluss, Gemeinnützigkeit) und verantwortest die Abrechnung unserer Förderprojekte gegenüber öffentlichen und privaten Mittelgebern. Die vorbereitende Buchhaltung läuft schlank und zunehmend automatisiert; du verantwortest sie, verbesserst sie weiter und entscheidest mit, ob und wann eine unterstützende Office-Rolle dazukommt.

Team führen: Wir arbeiten in Zwei-Wochen-Sprints. Du steuerst Planung, Review und die Aufgabenverteilung über alle laufenden Projekte und führst die Personalgespräche; über Neueinstellungen ins Team entscheiden wir gemeinsam. Du bist die Person, bei der die Fäden zusammenlaufen und du entwickelst unser Arbeitsformat weiter.

Projekte steuern: Wir betreiben mehrere Plattformprojekte parallel (Fördermittelkompass, Partnerportale, geförderte Programme, Reflecta Netzwerk). Die strategischen Schwerpunkte setzen wir gemeinsam; innerhalb dieses Rahmens hältst du Zeitpläne, Kapazitäten und Zusagen im Blick und entscheidest, was wann Priorität hat. Die technische Entwicklung führt unser Mitgründer und CTO Simon, die Produktvision liegt bei Daniela.

Verwaltung und Recht im Blick behalten: Verträge, Fristen, Registerpflichten, dazu ein überschaubarer Versicherungsbestand. Vieles davon ist digitalisiert; du trägst die Verantwortung und entscheidest, was du selbst machst, delegierst oder weiter automatisierst.

Remote arbeiten, in Berlin präsent sein: Dein Wohnort ist flexibel innerhalb Deutschlands, wir arbeiten alle remote. Termine in Berlin gehören aber fest zu deiner Rolle, und nicht alle sind lange planbar: Es kann vorkommen, dass eine Konferenz oder ein Partnertermin mit einer Woche Vorlauf ansteht und du dabei bist. Das sollte für dich organisatorisch gut machbar sein. Unser Büro in Berlin-Mitte oder ein anderer Co-Working Space steht dir offen. Du bist außerdem bei Branchen- und Netzwerk-Events für Reflecta unterwegs. Wenn du Lust auf Sichtbarkeit hast, auf Panels, Bühnen oder im Netzwerk unseres Sektors, gibt es dafür Raum.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in kaufmännischer Leitung, Geschäftsführung oder als COO, idealerweise in einer gemeinnützigen Organisation, einem Sozialunternehmen oder einem kleinen Digitalunternehmen.
  • Du hast nachweislich Teams geführt, idealerweise remote oder hybrid: Du kennst verteiltes Arbeiten aus der Praxis, kommunizierst asynchron und schriftlich klar und hältst Entscheidungen so fest, dass sie ohne Meeting nachvollziehbar sind. Menschen arbeiten gern mit dir und sagen dir auch Unbequemes.
  • Du arbeitest täglich sicher mit digitalen Tools (Projektmanagement, Wissensdatenbank, Team-Chat, cloudbasierte Dokumente) und findest dich in neuen Tools schnell zurecht. KI-gestützte Prozesse sind bei uns Alltag: Wir automatisieren viel und erwarten Neugier, keine Perfektion.
  • Du kannst Zahlen: Budgets, Liquidität. DATEV-Auswertungen liest du sicher.
  • Du bist mit Fördermitteln vertraut: Zuwendungen, Mittelabrufe, Verwendungsnachweise, die Logik öffentlicher und privater Mittelgeber. Du musst nicht jedes Programm kennen, aber du weißt, wie Fördergeld funktioniert und was Gemeinnützigkeit in der Praxis bedeutet.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich und holst dir bei offenen Fragen gezielt Informationen und Sparring. Bei Unsicherheit klärst du die Entscheidungsgrundlage, machst einen Vorschlag und ziehst die richtigen Personen ein, statt Themen liegen zu lassen.
  • Du bist hands-on und flexibel: Du bist bereit, operative Aufgaben selbst anzupacken, während du gleichzeitig Prozesse baust, die wiederkehrende Arbeit vereinfachen oder delegierbar machen. Du lädst auch selbst Belege hoch, springst ein, wo es brennt, und baust parallel die Prozesse, die genau das Schritt für Schritt überflüssig machen.
  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich und mündlich sehr sicher auf Deutsch, weil Fördermittelabrechnungen, Verträge, Behördenkommunikation und Teamführung überwiegend auf Deutsch laufen.
  • Du arbeitest gut in einem remote-first Team, kommunizierst klar über Distanz und hältst Zusammenarbeit, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen auch dann verlässlich zusammen, wenn einzelne Führungspersonen viel unterwegs sind.

Diese Rolle passt nicht, wenn

  • du eine reine Finanzrolle suchst. Die Hälfte dieser Rolle ist Führung und Steuerung von Menschen und Projekten.
  • du eine reine Führungsrolle suchst. Die andere Hälfte sind Zahlen, Abrechnungen und Verwaltungsverantwortung.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

Required

  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


Your playing field

Here's why this role matters for our mission.

  • Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
  • As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
  • Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.


How you'll make a difference

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the table

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


Benefits

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

Now it's your turn.

  • Click on ‘Apply now’ - it’ll only take 2 minutes.
  • All we need is your CV. You can tell us the rest in our simple, short application form.
  • Don’t meet all the requirements? If you think you’re still a good fit - just apply

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Build and maintain reliable, scalable data infrastructure

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry
